title: Master & PhD Programmes
about: The Geneva Graduate Institute accepts applications to its master's and PhD programmes for the 2027 intake until Thursday, 14 January 2027; recommendation letters are due 22 January 2027. This is the only deadline at which master's applicants can submit financial aid requests.
